evidence.claim: Della Foglia produce valvole a sfera dal 1962, nello stabilimento di 40.000 m² a Gorla Minore.
evidence.quote: DELLA FOGLIA was founded in 1962 by Mr. and Mrs. Della Foglia as a small artisan company of ball and needle valves. || Our production plant: 40.000 sqm located in Gorla Minore || Our goal towards clients, EPC, licensee and end users is to satisfy their needs using a problem-solving approach.
